body:
This seems to be an issue about AnimationPlayer interpolation, after adding a `@export var float_prop: float` and animating it with the same key frames as for the `PathFollow3D.progress_ratio`, it shows that it ends up with a very small value less than zero:

[path_follow_3d_60fps_bug_v2.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18307178/path_follow_3d_60fps_bug_v2.zip)
v4.4.dev7.official [46c8f8c5c] with Move Maker mode enabled:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c0c54cb6-f838-4af4-be7b-11315b5b8d2e)



Assigning a very small value less than zero to `PathFollow3D.progress_ratio` when `PathFollow3D.loop = true` resulting in the `progress_ratio` being wrapped around and thus set to `1.0`-ish  makes sense to me.

So AFAICT the issue is that AnimationPlayer tries to assign such value in the first place. cc @TokageItLab
